selection: First scan point after P3; all original shots 1 through 100; selection fixed before reading P4 agreement outcomes.
admission: Check two distinct TGA members and both 36-bit Pic logs per original shot, (Series,DataSetNr,RunNr) identity, monotone round timestamps, original image layout and size, P1/P4 detector rectangles, control configuration, timing and output lists.
rule: Sum over the 36 native P1 3x3 half-open rectangles in P4 raw pixels; strict count > T, no shifts, no background subtraction.
acceptance: Assess each fixed integer threshold separately against all original P4 Pic1/Pic2 log bits (7200 if 100 valid pairs). Report all thresholds, exact mismatch direction and identities, intersections with P3 focus, independent cohort masks and denominators. No P4 threshold refit.
selection_rule: Pic1 count of all occupied sites >=16/36, independently for log and predicted mask. Pic2 target comprises zero-based ROI 7-10,13-16,19-22,25-28; report both point filling and fully occupied rounds.
scope: Same-series holdout on Knottnerus 88Sr; cross-apparatus comparison to Senoo 171Yb. Formal Senoo CAL/VAL uses its own measured inputs.
